# Configuration

tfcensus reads its settings in layers, and a later layer wins: the defaults, the user file (`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tfcensus/config.yaml`), the project file (`.tfcensus.yaml`, found by walking up from the working directory), environment variables and flags. `tfcensus config show --sources` prints each value and its layer, and `tfcensus config init` writes the commented template at the end of this page. Files are checked against [config-v1.json](/schemas/config-v1.json).

A key's environment variable is `TFCENSUS_` followed by the key in upper case, with dots and dashes as underscores. Only scalars and string lists (comma-separated) can be set this way. See [environment variables](/reference/environment).

## schema_version

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `integer` | `1` | `1` | `TFCENSUS_SCHEMA_VERSION` |  |

Config file format version.

## rules

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of object` | `[]` |  |  |  |

Ownership rules, tried in order after the built-in packs. The first rule that matches an unmanaged resource sets its category.

Each entry has these fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Rule name, shown in findings as user/&lt;name&gt;. |
| `category` | `string` | Category of the resources the rule matches. |
| `owner` | `string` | Who owns the matched resources, such as datadog. |
| `match` | `string` | CEL expression that returns a bool, over resource and unit. |
| `reason` | `string` | Why the matched resources aren't unmanaged. |
| `expires` | `string` | Last day the rule applies, as a quoted "YYYY-MM-DD" date (UTC). After it the rule stops matching and scan warns. |

### audit.suppress

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of object` | `[]` |  |  |  |

Suppressions. A finding matching every set field of an entry is suppressed until expires.

Each entry has these fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `check` | `string` | Check ID or glob, such as S3-MFA or LK-\*. |
| `bucket` | `string` | Bucket name glob. |
| `unit` | `string` | Unit glob, repo/path. |
| `key` | `string` | State key or lock table glob. |
| `reason` | `string` | Why the finding is accepted. |
| `expires` | `string` | Last day the suppression applies, as a quoted "YYYY-MM-DD" date (UTC). After it the finding comes back with a warning. |

## drift

### drift.mode

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `refresh-only` | `refresh-only`, `full` | `TFCENSUS_DRIFT_MODE` | `--mode` |

refresh-only reports drift; full also tells drift the plan reverts from drift it keeps.

### drift.collapse

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `shape` | `shape`, `strict`, `none` | `TFCENSUS_DRIFT_COLLAPSE` | `--collapse` |

How identical changes in several units become one group.

### drift.never_hide

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of string` | `["delete","replace"]` | `create`, `update`, `delete`, `replace` | `TFCENSUS_DRIFT_NEVER_HIDE` |  |

Drift actions that no noise rule can hide.

### drift.noise

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of object` | `[]` |  |  |  |

Noise rules, tried in order. A rule hides the matching attribute changes, or the whole change when it has no attribute.

Each entry has these fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `preset` | `string` | A built-in rule. A preset entry takes no other key. |
| `name` | `string` | Rule name, shown on hidden drift as user/&lt;name&gt;. |
| `unit` | `string` | Unit path glob; \* matches any characters, / included. |
| `type` | `string` | Resource type glob, such as aws\_s3\_\*. |
| `address` | `string` | Resource address glob, such as module.tags.\*. |
| `attribute` | `string` | Attribute path such as tags\_all or ingress\[\*\].cidr\_blocks. It also matches everything below it. |
| `action` | `string` | Drift action. |
| `reason` | `string` | Why the drift is noise. Required for rules. |
| `expires` | `string` | Last day the rule applies, as a quoted "YYYY-MM-DD" date (UTC). After it the rule stops hiding drift and drift warns. |

## Template

`tfcensus config init` writes this file:

```yaml
# tfcensus configuration, written by 'tfcensus config init'.
# Each key below is commented out and shows its default. Uncomment a key to change it.
# Later layers win: defaults < user file < project file < env (TFCENSUS_*) < flags.
# 'tfcensus config show --sources' prints every effective value and where it came from, and
# 'tfcensus config validate' checks this file. Unknown keys are errors. Credentials never go here.
schema_version: 1
#
# binaries:
#   terragrunt: terragrunt         # a name on PATH or a path
#   terraform: terraform           # terraform or tofu, passed to terragrunt as --tf-path
#   tofu: tofu                     # reads OpenTofu encrypted state when state.decrypt_with_tofu is on
#
# discovery:
#   roots: []                      # directories to discover units in
#   generate_stacks: false         # run terragrunt stack generate before discovery
#   render: auto                   # auto, always or never
#
# accounts:
#   profiles: []                   # AWS profile globs from ~/.aws/config, for example ["acme-*"]
#   include: []                    # account IDs doctor, scan and whois list; empty means all
#   exclude: []                    # account IDs doctor, scan and whois skip
#   org:
#     enabled: false               # list the organization's accounts and assume a role in each
#     management_profile: ""       # profile that lists the accounts; empty means the default credentials
#     role: OrganizationAccountAccessRole
#     ou_roles: {}                 # OU or root ID to the role used for the accounts directly under it
#   map: {}                        # account ID to profile and name, for example {"111111111111": {profile: acme-nonprod, name: acme-nonprod}}
#   aggregator:                    # AWS Config aggregator
#     profile: ""
#     name: ""
#     region: ""
#
# state:
#   decrypt_with_tofu: false       # run tofu init and tofu show -json in units whose state is encrypted
#
# regions: []                      # empty means the regions in the units' backends and providers
# all_regions: false               # every region each account has enabled, instead of regions
#
# scan:
#   layers: auto                   # auto, or a comma-separated list of re, config, cc and native
#   cloudcontrol_types: []         # more types listed through Cloud Control (VPC Lattice is always)
#   cloudformation: true           # list stack resources; what a stack lists and no state manages is other-iac
#   packs:                         # built-in ownership rule packs
#     aws-defaults: true
#     aws-service: true
#     other-iac: true
#     derived: true
#     ephemeral: true
#   never_hide: []                 # categories user rules can't give to IAM users
#   external_dns:                  # TXT registry settings of your external-dns deployments
```
